climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A PDO in the Duna region, a mostly flat area between the Danube and Tisza rivers with sandy soil. Blaufränkisch leads plantings at 24%, followed by Riesling at 9% and Kövidinka at 8%.
